scope: Mount complete actual Composer including private QueuePanel/QueueRow, actual queue.actionStep and prompt/shortcut modules. Replace only editor, nonparticipating platform/menu boundaries and DOM focus endpoint. No product source patch or disabled callback invocation.
ordinary_conditions: Enabled non-minimized full Composer; a real active working queue containing q1/q2/q3 from queue.submit; no disabled override; q2 has its ordinary retained attachment; enter edit through visible enabled Edit button; exit through visible enabled Cancel/Save or real configured Escape/Enter handler. Expected return focus is an invocation of the existing exact-row focus port for the surviving edited ID, once; it is not a claim of browser/native activeElement parity.
decisive: Cancel button on surviving middle q2 focuses q2 exactly once and leaves items unchanged
Escape on surviving middle q2 is consumed, cancels and focuses q2 exactly once
Save button on surviving middle q2 commits text, preserves row/attachment and focuses q2 exactly once
Enter on surviving middle q2 is consumed, commits text and focuses q2 exactly once
Cancel button on surviving head q1 focuses q1, not last or adjacent row
Save button on surviving head q1 focuses q1, not last or adjacent row
controls: Entering edit still calls editor.focus(end) and does not focus any display row
Rerender after edit exit does not repeat any row-focus invocation
No-edit mount and unrelated rerender do not focus a row or mutate the queue
Editing rerender preserves editor custody and does not focus a display row
Direct q1-to-q2 edit switch does not trigger exit restoration
Save and steer removes edited q2 and never queries/focuses an absent q2
Explicit deletion of edited q2 clears editing without querying/focusing it
Idle head drain after normal Save removes q1 and never focuses the absent row
Workspace-style session-key switch does not restore the old session's row
Session-key remount with same editing ID performs entry focus only
Blank Save and Save-and-steer remain disabled without invoking disabled callbacks
Blank Enter and meta-Enter are consumed without save dispatch or return focus
1476 collapsed two-to-one-to-two remains revealed/expanded, with no unrelated row focus
Re-entering a previously cancelled edit retains caret-at-end entry behavior
expected_before: Six decisive semantic assertions are predicted to fail; fourteen controls are predicted to pass. Predictions are not observed results. Setup, imports, transpilation or missing-node errors are not semantic RED.
runtime_limits: Requires explicit canonical serialized reservation. One CPU0, one foreground Node; 60s plus 5s kill grace and at most 30s cleanup; heap768MiB, estimated RSS<=1.5GiB, incremental disk<=16MiB. In-slot Node capability gate must fail closed. No install/version probe before admission, no extra test/build/parser/browser/native/provider command.
honest_gaps: No backend race or provider behavior claim
